name: Advance Universal Modern Portfolio and Gallery (AUMP)
author: Muhammad Abbas

sections.description:
Advance Universal Modern Portfolio and Gallery (AUMP) is a powerful and flexible plugin designed to help you create stunning portfolios and galleries with ease. Built on custom post types and featuring a fully responsive layout with sleek, modern popups, AUMP delivers exceptional performance across all devices.

This all-in-one, multipurpose solution supports images, video, audio, and text — giving you complete creative freedom. Best of all, AUMP is fully compatible with any page builder, so you can design portfolio items exactly the way you want.

See Live Demo | Customization and Support

Advance Universal Modern Portfolio and Gallery (AUMP) is a cutting-edge WordPress plugin that lets you create sophisticated portfolio and gallery showcases. Its intuitive visual builder (Gutenberg block or shortcode) makes it easy to design beautiful galleries without any coding it offers a handy shortcode [aump_portfolio]. With advanced layouts and performance-first design, AUMP delivers lightning-fast, SEO-friendly portfolio galleries that look great on any device. It’s perfect for photographers, creative agencies, freelancers, businesses, designers, developers and bloggers — anyone who needs to present their work in a modern, engaging way

Key Features:

  • Create portfolios using a dedicated Custom Post Type.
  • Embed videos from YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Facebook and more, or add self-hosted video/audio directly in galleries using your native editor
  • Support all page builders (Elementor, WPBakery, Divi, etc.). It integrates with SEO plugins (Yoast, All in One SEO, Rank Math) and optimization tools.
  • Responsive, modern layouts.
  • Beautiful popup viewer with navigation and detailed info.
  • Customize settings like layout, popup behavior, and more.
  • Built to WordPress coding standards for speed and security.

🚀 Fast Performance & SEO-Friendly

  • ⚡ Smart Lazy Loading: Images load only as users scroll, so initial page loads are blazing fast. As Cloudflare notes, speedy websites bring “better SEO, higher conversion rates, and an improved user experience”.

  • 🧩 Lightweight & Modular: AUMP’s code is optimized and modular. Assets (scripts & styles) are only loaded on pages with galleries, keeping the plugin lean and efficient.

  • 📱 Responsive & Mobile-First: Fully responsive design ensures portfolios shine on desktops, tablets and phones. This aligns with Google’s mobile-first indexing – Google now prioritizes sites with responsive, fast-loading content.

✨ Advanced Layouts & Visual Effects

  • 🔲 Flexible Layouts: Mix and match layouts to highlight projects exactly how you want.

  • 🎨 Hover Animations: Modern CSS3 hover effect for long images on grid, add polish and interactivity. These GPU-accelerated effects run smoothly on all devices

  • 🔍 Retina-Ready Lightbox: A high-performance lightbox (FancyBox/PhotoSwipe) opens images and descriptions with mobile-optimized touch navigation. Popups are retina-ready and support swipe, zoom and user-friendly navigations.

🎥 Rich Media & Interactivity

  • 🎬 Video & Audio Support: Embed videos from YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Facebook and more, or add self-hosted video/audio directly in galleries. Rich media like video “increases the time people spent on a page,” leading to lower bounce rates and higher engagement.

  • 🔍 Filtering & Sorting: Let visitors dynamically filter or sort portfolio items by taxonomy. Stylish filter layouts and animations make navigation intuitive.

  • ⚡ Smart Loading: Beyond lazy-loading images, AUMP ensures all media is loaded on-demand. This keeps page sizes small and speeds up load times, enhancing SEO and user experience.

🛠️ Easy Builder & Developer-Friendly

  • 🧱 Visual Builder: Live Gutenberg block and shortcode builders with WYSIWYG controls – no coding needed. Instantly style layouts, captions, filters and more with a point-and-click interface.

  • 🔌 Fully Extensible: AUMP offers template overrides for maximum flexibility. You can add custom CSS and customize PHP code to tailor every aspect of your galleries.

  • ⚙️ Themes & Plugins: 100% theme-agnostic – works seamlessly with any theme and major page builders (Elementor, WPBakery, Divi, etc.). It integrates with SEO plugins (Yoast, All in One SEO, Rank Math) and optimization tools.

  • 🌐 Translation & RTL: Built with international sites in mind – fully translatable and compatible with WPML/Polylang. Right-to-left languages (Arabic, Hebrew, etc.) are supported out of the box.

🎯 Perfect For Any Creator

  • 📸 Photographers & Videographers: Showcase photo and video portfolios with sleek, professional galleries.
  • 🎨 Creative Agencies & Designers: Present case studies or art projects in eye-catching layouts.
  • 💻 Freelancers & Developers: Highlight projects and work samples with a modern look.
  • 💼 Businesses & Startups: Display product showcases, team galleries, or services to impress clients.
  • ✍️ Bloggers & Content Creators: Enhance posts with organized image galleries and media collections.

AUMP is a modern, versatile portfolio and gallery solution designed to enhance user engagement and site interactivity. By beautifully showcasing your visual content and optimizing performance, AUMP helps grow your audience and boost SEO. For an authoritative, high-performance portfolio plugin, AUMP is the ideal choice.

AUMP’s use of fast performance is backed by Cloudflare’s findings on site speed and SEO. Responsive, mobile-friendly design is a Google-recommended best practice. Video content is proven to increase on-page engagement. And Visual Portfolio examples show how advanced layouts and customizable builder tools can elevate user engagement. All these features together make AUMP a powerful, SEO-friendly portfolio and gallery plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/advanced-universal-modern-portfolio directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. A new “Aump Portfolio” menu will appear in your dashboard.
  4. Add your portfolio items, customize settings, and display your portfolio using the provided shortcode [aump_portfolio].
sections.faq:
Why is the image on the grid view empty or blank?

Please ensure that you have selected a featured image for the item. Once you do, the image will appear on the grid view.

How do I display the portfolio on a page?

Use the shortcode [aump_portfolio] on any post or page, or use the provided Gutenberg block if available.

Can I customize the popup layout?

Yes, popup styles are configurable from the plugin settings panel, and developers can also override templates.

Will it slow down my site?

Not at all. It’s optimized for performance and follows WordPress best practices.
